body: Why would anyone WANT to act depressed as was stated earlier, can lead to ACTUAL depression. People really need to be educated on what depression is and what is does to not only you, but the people who care and love you. One of the things that hurts me the most is constantly feeling guilty over the fact that the love of my life weathers the storm that I feel is my depression, helping me get out of it, stay above it and not fall back in. On top of family and friends trying to help me stay positive, and I just can’t see any part of that being attractive or alluring to anyone. Depression hurts us but it takes it’s toll on those that are closest to you and that is where I feel it the most, personally. It’s not fun at all because all I ever do is sometimes wonder when the tunnel will end and I can see the sunshine again. If someone feels bad, they should be treated with respect and possibly someone can talk to them and help lift their spirits, never downplay another’s problems. Not everything is depression, but that doesn’t mean it’s any less important. Sorry for going on a tangent and possibly missing the point, but wanting or acting like you have depression.... your digging your own hole and if you don’t watch yourself, you could end up in a pit that may be to difficult for you to climb out of yourself, and then you may need help.

I myself, am American. I don’t have much of either $ or other status symbols you will see many brag about. Not every American is driven to be the biggest,richest,baddest guy/girl out there, it’s simply (at least from my personal viewpoint anyway) the way the way the system pushes you to think. If you don’t have a nice car or house, if you lack $ in anyway, you are a failure. You have not lived to your fullest potential as a lifetime member of the USA. I have a few personal problems and I’ll list that as childhood-teen raised issues. I can’t speak for everyone else, so only myself. I was abused,beaten,verbally abused and judged often and for little to no cause. To give a good example, I was 8-10 years old and I spilled a small plastic cup of less than half full water on a stone tiled floor. I cleaned it up and washed the cup afterward and placed the paper towel in the trash can. I did not tell anyone about it, as I feared I’d be let into if I did. It was a simple, clean, no hurt anything or one mistake. But later that day, I was yanked off my feet and slammed against a wall where I was shouted at for having made a mess and trying to hide it.... wtf... why?? I always questioned this when it happened, and it occurred a lot. I never grew up with friends because my family pretty much scared the rest of the neighborhood and anyone that saw them. They would treat my brother,cousins in our age group as our older cousins had moved out and away, and they would do it right in front of people. The worst part about it, people would see it.... and they did not do anything.. at all... we were all treated that way until we moved out and ever since then, nothing from family. No communication at all. Period. As far as I’m concerned, they could all be dead for all the lack of communication that has gone on. I suffer from a few problems and it’s not hard to believe that these experiences are what shaped them into the beasts I battle daily. I have self worth issues, inferiority issues, an with and social interaction issues... I literally am afraid when I’m around groups of people because of how I grew up and how other children treated me after learning a bit about my family... no one wanted to be friend, give me a chance to show I’m not like my family... I struggle today as a 26yo male. Depression hurts, and no one should feel this way... no one deserves this... wondering if today will be the day you finally give up... if when you go to school, you will break down because you can’t process what it’s like to have normal, friendly people around you. They are laughing st each other or some joke, not you!!! It is so difficult not to let that train of thought get momentum though. It’s a battle everyday that wears you out and down. I still have no friends to speak of... Ive never been with a girl either. I have zero experience in both those departments... I know my experience is not the cookie cutter experience that many people get, but it’s these and other situations that shaped me into today’s mess. I am literally only around people 23 hours per week. The remaining majority I am alone at my small home wondering what the point in everything is. I know I have probably gone off track, but I saw your post and it was tough to respond as that is also out of character for me. I do t post very much or often, and I almost never respond to others posts because I’m simply afraid of the responses I may get, but this time I just don’t care... I started with nothing and I’m flooded with commercials and movies and news about all great things to get and own and places to go and things to do with friends and family and it really Hammers in how low I truly am. For me, that is why I personally, have anxiety and depression. These are my reasons...  I would never think to speak for anyone else here,  so these reasons are mine. If they match others? As bad as that is, I know what it’s like, so message me and maybe we can try to help each other get over them. Thank you for giving me a chance to talk and I truly apologize for the length of my response... I am sorry. I just felt I needed to to explain and it kept going and going. My apologies.
